fact: The Kenya Space Agency says Kenya launched the CroME Initiative with the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development, Microsoft AI for Good Lab and NASA Harvest, using satellite images and AI to provide crop maps, crop growth monitoring, yield predictions and crop damage detection.
